name: cr715_3d_another_effect_may_cast_it_as_an_adventure
why: CR 715.3d: other effects that let a player cast it may let them cast it as an Adventure: Brazen Borrower exiled by Light Up the Stage is cast as Petty Theft from exile, and resolving it exiles the card again, now under the Adventure's own permission.
